content.text: Made it back at 4:20 AM, fairly uneventful trip. Sitting here with my Momma at her place eating some hot water cornbread. Taking my wife to Arkansas this weekend for High School reunion.  Since I don’t have a double name like Billy Bob or ███y Don; I figured on heading to a tattoo parlor shortly to get some misspelled tattoos so I’ll fit in over there.  Thank you for checking in on me.

Loved “Made it back at 4:20 AM, fairly uneventful trip. Sitting here with my Momma at her place eating some hot water cornbread. Taking my wife to Arkansas this weekend for High School reunion.  Since I don’t have a double name like Billy Bob or ███y Don; I figured on heading to a tattoo parlor shortly to get some misspelled tattoos so I’ll fit in over there.  Thank you for checking in on me.”
Sounds like your retirement has gotten off to a great start!
Spend some time with your mom and give me a call later. I’m not gonna put anything out there until I talk to you.
Just circling back, I think they are announcing staff changes tonight. I got the info, so I’m going to put it out there so I get the “scoop”. I just wanted to let you know

That’s fine, still at my Mother’s house. Al made me a great offer to stay and I believe they are on the right path. I simply had to weigh all my options here at home and the Tiger’s offer fell short of the greater need here at home.....pretty simple and straightforward. I told Al I was extremely grateful for the opportunity to be a Coach in the Tigers organization.  I will be happy to give you my thoughts on anything else once the story breaks.
Thank you for getting back to me. Call whenever. Congrats on an outstanding career

I appreciate all the kind words you wrote about me over the two years I was with the Tigers.  You do a fantastic job and I hope things work out well for you. Headed back to my house to carry my daughter to basketball practice. I wish you nothing but the best with the issues you are dealing with in your life.  I enjoyed our time together in Detroit. Make Crunk behave himself.
I appreciate that more than you know. You will probably be inundated with calls/texts, but let’s catch up this week. Take care.
